# roadie_action (Resource)

Manages a Roadie action.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "roadie_action" "list_repos" {
  name        = "List Repositories"
  slug        = "list-repositories"
  description = "Lists repositories from GitHub."
  enabled     = true

  parameters = [
    {
      name        = "org"
      type        = "string"
      description = "The GitHub organization to list repositories for."
      required    = true
    },
  ]

  steps = [
    {
      id             = "fetch_repos"
      integration_id = roadie_integration.github.id
      request = jsonencode({
        method  = "GET"
        path    = "/orgs/{{org}}/repos"
        headers = [{ key = "Accept", value = "application/json" }]
        body    = ""
      })
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the action.
- `steps` (Attributes List) The steps that make up the action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--steps))

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the action.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the action is enabled.
- `metadata` (String) Arbitrary metadata as JSON.
- `mode` (String) The action mode (read or write). If omitted, derived from steps.
- `parameters` (Attributes List) Input parameters for the action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters))
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly identifier. Auto-derived from name if omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the action was created.
- `current_version` (Number) The current version number, auto-incremented on each update.
- `effective_mode` (String) The resolved mode (explicit or derived from steps).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the action.
- `input_schema` (String) The computed JSON Schema for action inputs.
- `updated_at` (String) When the action was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--steps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `steps`

Required:

- `id` (String) Step identifier (must match /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/).
- `integration_id` (String) The integration to use for this step.
- `request` (String) The request configuration as JSON (HTTP or AWS request object).


<a id="nestedatt--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameters`

Required:

- `name` (String) The parameter name.
- `type` (String) The parameter type.

Optional:

- `default` (String) Default value as JSON.
- `description` (String) A description of the parameter.
- `required` (Boolean) Whether the parameter is required.
